fetch_rule: one plain-HTTP pass, python scripts/claude/r3_fetch.py --label heldout1-a, started after the first pull ends; no browser fetch, no second pass; no page version stored after the pass ends is read
truth: pairs of readable own-site pages of the first pull; consensus when the second pull orders the pair the same way, a page missing from the second pull ranking below every page present; excluded only when both pages are missing

pass_rule.interval: two-way bootstrap over sites and search groups
